company.name: 99designs
company.one_liner: Global creative platform for collaboration between designers and clients

summary: 99designs is a global creative platform where businesses commission custom design work, such as logos, websites, packaging and branding, from a community of vetted freelance designers. Accel lists the company as having received a Series A investment in 2011 and as having been acquired by Vistaprint.
business_model: Marketplace connecting clients with freelance designers via design contests, 1-to-1 projects, and a branding agency service.
customers: Businesses and entrepreneurs needing logos, branding, websites, packaging and other design work.
